S27.01.needs: a signed-in AGI Cloud account with artifacts, including one with no title
S27.01.note: The Artifacts tree class exists but no tree view is registered, so the list the person sees is the quick pick; there is no separate card or viewer title beyond the row name and tab name.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud with an account that has artifacts.
Open the Command Palette and run "Code: Show Artifacts".
Look at each row: the row name should be the artifact's title.
Find an artifact with no title and check the row shows "Untitled" followed by its type.
Click a row to open it and check the editor tab name matches the title.
S27.01.where: Command Palette > Code: Show Artifacts > pick a row in the "Code, Artifacts" list (placeholder "Open an artifact…")

S27.15.note: There is no floating toolbar in the code; the selection actions are the editor right-click menu and the code-action (lightbulb) menu, which only appear when text is selected.
steps: Open any code file and select several lines.
Look for "Code: Explain Selection" and "Code: Refactor Code" in the menu.
Press Cmd+. (or click the lightbulb) with the selection still active.
Look for "Refactor with" followed by the product name "Code" and "Explain with" in the list.
S27.15.where: Select some text in an editor > right-click > Code: Explain Selection or Code: Refactor Code; or click the lightbulb (or press Cmd+.) and look for Refactor with Code

S27.37.needs: a signed-in AGI Cloud account with a Markdown artifact
S27.37.note: No command is named or labelled as Markdown export. The closest path is saving an artifact into the workspace; the file gets a .md extension only when the artifact's language is markdown (artifactPresentation.ts maps markdown to md).
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud with an account that has a Markdown artifact.
Run "Code: Show Artifacts" from the Command Palette.
Hover the Markdown artifact row and click the save icon labelled "Save into the workspace".
In the save dialog, choose a folder and keep the suggested name.
Check the saved file name ends in .md and that its content matches the artifact.
S27.37.where: Command Palette > Code: Show Artifacts > hover a row > click the save icon "Save into the workspace" (command "Code: Save Artifact into Workspace")
